# Tasks Document

- [ ] 1. Affine math module
  - Files: veccy/controllers/affine.py, veccy/controllers/svg_io.py, tests/test_affine.py
  - `Affine` tuple type, `IDENTITY`, `compose`, `apply`, `invert`, `translation`, `rotation`, `scaling`, `is_identity`, `as_rotation`; move svg_io's `_compose`/`_apply` here and import them in svg_io
  - Purpose: One Qt-free source of 2D affine math for model, render, gestures and SVG
  - _Leverage: veccy/controllers/svg_io.py `_compose`, `_apply`, `Matrix`, `_IDENTITY`_
  - _Requirements: 4.1, 4.5_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec shape-handles, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Python developer with 2D geometry experience | Task: Create veccy/controllers/affine.py per design.md (controllers/affine.py component) using SVG matrix(a b c d e f) order; replace svg_io's private matrix helpers with imports from it; pytest for compose order, invert round trip (and ValueError on singular), rotation about a point, as_rotation round trip and None for skew/scale, is_identity tolerance | Restrictions: stdlib only, no Qt, no numpy; keep svg_io behavior identical (existing tests must pass); say "type" not "kind" in names | Success: tests/test_affine.py and full suite pass. Before starting set this task to [-] in tasks.md; after finishing log it with log-implementation (with artifacts) and set it to [x]._

- [ ] 2. Shape transform field and canonical transform_shape
  - Files: veccy/models/shapes.py, veccy/controllers/geometry.py, tests/test_geometry.py
  - Add `transform` (identity default, last field) to all four shapes; `outline` applies it; `translate` keeps rotation centered; new `transform_shape(shape, m, min_extent)`, `rotation_of`, `with_rotation`
  - Purpose: Rotated rect/ellipse/text stay their shape type; scale goes into geometry, stroke unchanged
  - _Leverage: geometry.transform_segments, geometry.outline, controllers/affine.py_
  - _Requirements: 2.7, 2.8, 2.9, 2.10, 3.4, 3.5, 3.7, 3.8, 4.1, 4.4_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec shape-handles, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Python developer with computational geometry experience | Task: Implement the model field and geometry functions per design.md (models/shapes.py and controllers/geometry.py sections): canonical form = unrotated geometry + rotation about center/anchor, identity when angle ~0, skew kept as general matrix, paths baked, text uniform by max factor and keeps previous rotation on flip, extents clamped to min_extent; tests for each case including flip, skew, translate of rotated rect, outline with transform | Restrictions: Shapes stay frozen; existing positional constructors must keep working; no Qt; no render imports in geometry | Success: new and existing tests pass; unrotated shapes still have identity transform after scale. Before starting set this task to [-] in tasks.md; after finishing log it with log-implementation (with artifacts) and set it to [x]._

  - PathCache builds world-space paths (transform applied); `geometry_bounds`; `from_skia_path`; `draw_shape` concatenates `shape.transform` around drawRect/drawOval/drawTextBlob
  - Purpose: Canvas, export, hit-testing, bounds and booleans all see transforms
  - _Leverage: render/paths.py PathCache, render/text.py text_path, geometry.quad_to_cubic_
  - _Requirements: 4.2, 4.3_
